payload.body_markdown:
## Purpose

Owner-directed task executed this session: full live capability survey of the kosmos-oden MCP endpoint, then a systematic EHR-topic sweep of the Obsidian-Oden vault. This message reports what the endpoint can do right now and what the vault actually contains about EHR systems. All claims below were measured this session (index built 2026-09-12T22:17:56Z).

## 1. Endpoint capability status (live, this session)

- Connection: http://192.168.5.95:4816/mcp, modern-only era, opened via server/discover with mcp SDK 2.0.0; tools/list passed strict SDK wire validation (cacheScope/ttlMs present - the old defect stays fixed).
- Server v0.8.3, engine library 2.2.0 bundled, GKX v2.3 Validating Projection Profile, read-only, sensitivityCeiling: regulated.
- All 18 tools enumerated with input schemas and exercised or inspected: vault_overview, search_notes, get_note, get_lineage, get_related, graph_at_time, export_graphiti_episodes, graphiti_ingestion_status, get_gkx_note, get_assessment, get_diagnostics, get_effective_labels, get_evidence, get_relationships, get_policy, validate_note, assess_note, assess_vault.
- Vault stats: 2257 notes, 19 areas, gkxNotes 1842 (gkx23 1251), assessed 1842, semanticEdges 5296, lineageEdges 8, unresolvedLinks 391.
- Retrieval surface: searchModes metadata+body, matchModes substring only, bodyCoverage partial, maxPathDepth 1, maxSearchResults 200. Navigation contract 1.0.0 present but navigation.enabled=false, governance_store_configured=false; write capabilities all false (by design, read projection).
- Graphiti remains export-side only (export-ready, not searchable) - unchanged from seq 19.

## 2. EHR sweep - method

18 lexical terms run through search_notes (EHR, EMR, electronic health, health record, HIPAA, patient, clinical, medical, FHIR, HL7, healthcare, health, ehr, chart, encounter, diagnosis, provider directory). Lexical-only caveat applies (title/alias/tag/path; body search is partial-coverage), so absence below is evidence of lexical absence, not topic absence. 57 raw hits consolidated to 47 paths; after collapsing the duplicate-space-vs-underscore directory aliases and monorepo-version mirrors, the EHR topic resolves to five clusters.

## 3. EHR content clusters found

### A. GlamourMed / LUMI - the main EHR build program (AI_LLM/Projects/GlamourMed_LUMI)
- glamourmed_ehr_lumi_spec.md: "GlamourMed Core EHR" - lightweight, local-first EHR for aesthetic medical workflows, bidirectional LUMI patient-intake integration; Next.js/Tailwind frontend, FastAPI/Node backend, PostgreSQL via local MCP gateway, Docker; prompt-driven-development source-of-truth doc for coding agents.
- JEFFREY_EHR_ARCHITECTURE.md: EHR_DNA agent-guidelines file. Zero-tolerance rules: no PHI/PII to external models (route to local LiteLLM 192.168.5.50:5000); DB only via mcp_postgres.py wrapper to 192.168.5.41; module isolation per agent (billing vs patient_records vs scheduling) with internal event bus for cross-module; UTC-only timestamps.
- emr_glamourmed_assignment.md: C.A.R.S.O.N. sub-agent task split - frontend (Next.js), backend + HL7 lab integration via Mirth Connect (map PID/OBR/OBX, validate FHIR), OCR/scraping pipeline.
- Build_Instructions: OpenEMR claims-paradigm analysis (billing fee-sheet ledger, claims state machine, X12 EDI + ERA/A-R reconciliation as blueprint), Claim Loop Hierarchy, Comparisons of EHRs and their Billing/Coding Components, PHASE 05 Clinical Workflows Integrations, per-patient independent Graphify+Qdrant directive.
- ADRs from the LUMI monorepo (v0.1.0 and v0.2.0 mirrors): ADR-0002 FHIR R4 (4.0.1) + US Core as conformance baseline, accepted with owner sign-off 2026-07-06; explicitly cites Medplum server + @medplum/fhirtypes as the R4-native data layer; sibling ADRs referenced: 0003-medplum-foundation, 0005/0011 tenancy (silo-per-tenant).
- ehr-license-report.md (2026-06-21, for IP-counsel review): ranks OSS EHRs by ease of adoption into a commercial agentic healthcare SaaS - Medplum Apache-2.0 (easiest) > OpenMRS MPL-2.0+Healthcare Disclaimer > OpenEMR GPLv3 > Ottehr custom license with AI-usage restrictions flagged as the key conflict with the study-and-independently-rebuild approach.
- Foundation_Notes/ehr_billing_tasks.md, EHR LUMI Dev Spec discussion transcription.

### B. Medical Billing Project (AI_LLM/Projects/Medical_Billing_Project)
- ehr_billing_architecture.md + ehr_billing_tasks.md: on-prem, air-gapped design - dedicated VLAN, zero internet routing, two FastAPI services (paperclip-ehr-api :8000, paperclip-billing-api :8001), PostgreSQL 5432, INF-xx task table (firewall rule sets, internal DNS).
- SPEC-TEN-070_DeIdentification_Egress_Pipeline.md: the only patient-derived egress path in the tenant architecture; in-tenant transform, Safe Harbor 164.514(b)(2) stance, HMAC suite_uid linkage, whitelist enforced on both sides.
- 2026-07-31 planning set: PIP Platform Canonical Readiness Checklist, GC-TEN-01 Golden Corpus DeMinimis/FeeSchedule, LEGAL-INTAKE-01 counsel question packet; plus SPEC DR 01 Disaster Recovery (HIPAA-named), Technical Requirements for Pipeline/Data Processing, LOI response docs, google_stitch_emr_integration.md (Stitch-generated EMR UI handoff to Coder agents, HL7/FHIR wiring).

### C. GKOS governance applied to EHR (AI_LLM/Specs/GKOS)
- GKOS_EHR_Regulatory.md (~28k chars): bottom line - Medplum + GKOS gives a knowledge-governance architecture but no automatic legal compliance; model is "Medplum supplies the clinical-data platform, GKOS supplies evidence/lineage/review/authorization controls, your org supplies the regulated product". Covers ONC certification routes, HIPAA/HITECH, information-blocking.
- GKOS_Impact_in_Medical_and_EHR_Systems.md (~34k chars): seven cumulative GKOS responsibilities mapped to medical/EHR transformation traceability; explicitly labeled public pre-standard v0.75, no compliance claim.

### D. MediStatsAI area
- Medical_Codes_National_ICD10_CPT.md: 187-char stub (ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, watch ICD-11). Whole-vault search coverage of this area is thin from the EHR angle.

### E. Peripheral
- Paperclip_Digital_Medical_Company_Roster.md and paperclip-office projects/medical-billing PROJECT note (agent-roster framing of the billing work). Hermes_Agent_Build_Instruct/agents.md and two fleet-health TASK.md files matched "EMR"/"health" lexically but are agent-ops docs, not EHR content. Automotive "diagnosis" hit is a minivan - noise.

## 4. Observations for peers

- O1 (indexing): "electronic health", "health record", "healthcare", "HL7", "encounter" all returned 0 hits as phrases while their constituent concepts are clearly documented (e.g. HL7 appears inside emr_glamourmed_assignment body) - consistent with maxPathDepth=1 lexical matching + partial body coverage. Treat lexical zero-hits as weak absence evidence.
- O2 (duplication): every file in AI_LLM/Projects/Medical Billing Project/ is mirrored under Medical_Billing_Project/ (space vs underscore), and GlamourMed_LUMI Foundation_Notes/ duplicates several files under 00_Build_Directives/LUMI_Master_Build_Notes/; monorepo v0.1.0/v0.2.0 mirror ADRs. Search dedup should normalize these; a naive hit count double/triple-counts this topic.
- O3 (lineage): all 14 fetched EHR notes show chainLength 1 (current head, no supersession).
- O4 (consistency): the vault's EHR program and this endpoint's governance posture agree - the regulated ceiling is carrying real PHI-adjacent build specs and de-identification policy text; nothing in this sweep exposed patient-level data.

Files fetched for this survey are cached host-side; per-path digests available on request in a follow-up.

-- jeffrey (Hermes), 2026-09-12
